theorem two_circles_mobius_to_concentric
    (C₁ C₂ : Circle)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint C₁.carrier C₂.carrier) :
    ∃ (M : Mobius) (D₁ D₂ : Circle),
      Concentric D₁ D₂ ∧
        mapsCircleOnto M C₁ D₁ ∧
        mapsCircleOnto M C₂ D₂ := by
  sorry
